How to get to CISPA

Our workshop on 2–3 December 2026 takes place at CISPA D1 (City Building) in St. Ingbert, near Saarbrücken.

Workshop venue

CISPA D1 (City Building)

Kaiserstraße 21
66386 St. Ingbert, Germany
Open D1 in Google Maps ↗

Please use this St. Ingbert address when planning your journey. CISPA’s main building, C0, is at Saarland University in Saarbrücken; its university-campus directions lead to a different location.

By train

Plan your journey to St. Ingbert railway station (Bahnhof). D1 is approximately 550 metres away, an eight-minute walk, at Kaiserstraße 21.

If you arrive at Saarbrücken Hauptbahnhof, plan your onward connection to St. Ingbert before the final walk to D1.

Plan a train journey ↗

By bus

Use Rendezvous-Platz, the central bus station in St. Ingbert, as your destination. From there, D1 is approximately 400 metres away, a six-minute walk.

Use Saarfahrplan to find a connection from your hotel or arrival point and check current departure times.

Plan local public transport ↗

By plane

CISPA lists Saarbrücken Airport (SCN) and Frankfurt Airport (FRA) as arrival options for the region. Plan onward travel to St. Ingbert, then follow the train or bus directions above.

If taking a taxi, give the driver the workshop address: Kaiserstraße 21, 66386 St. Ingbert.

By car

Set your navigation destination to Kaiserstraße 21, 66386 St. Ingbert.

CISPA’s D1 guide lists public parking near the town hall and on Wollbachstraße. Check the signs at your chosen parking area for current fees and time limits.

Venue and walking information: CISPA locations and CISPA’s D1 visitor information. Check the journey planners for services on your travel date.
